fields.name: Service type IEI
fields.description: Information Element Identifier for Service type

fields.name: Service type value
fields.description: Service type value indicating the purpose of the service request procedure. Values include: 0000 (mobile originating CS fallback or 1xCS fallback), 0001 (mobile terminating CS fallback or 1xCS fallback), 0010 (mobile originating CS fallback emergency call or 1xCS fallback emergency call), 0011 (unused - mobile originating CS fallback or 1xCS fallback if received by network), 0100 (unused - mobile originating CS fallback or 1xCS fallback if received by network), 1000 (packet services via S1), 1001/1010/1011 (unused - packet services via S1 if received by network). All other values are reserved.

notes: The Service type is a type 1 information element.
The purpose of the Service type information element is to specify the purpose of the service request procedure.
